repository.name: agid-postal-kz
repository.purpose: Kazakhstan postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Kazakhstan sheet dated 07/2025 documents transitional coexistence of a seven-character alphanumeric postcode and a legacy six-digit numeric index. Current 2026 assignment rules make the first Latin letter a capital, region or city-of-republican-significance code, the next two digits an address-block code, and the final letter-digit pairs a real-estate-object code within that block. The national postal operator assigns the code to a real-estate object included in the Digital Address Register. Production assignment requires an exact current operator or competent-authority record with code type, RKA or stable address identity where supplied, jurisdiction, validity, retrieval time, schema and digest pinned. A UPU example, prefix, pattern, search result, coordinate, model or third-party map does not create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Neither current nor legacy postcode is guaranteed to be a polygon. Never generate official postal geometry from code characters, an address block, post-office coverage, RKA, an office or address point, administrative or cadastral containment, proximity, Voronoi, interpolation or a model. Official geometry requires an exact operator or competent-authority artifact explicitly relating the typed code to a point, polygon or multipolygon and pinning authority, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, topology, licence and digest. Derived surfaces stay independently labelled.
postal_system.transition_rule: Store current_alphanumeric_real_estate_object and legacy_numeric_post_office as different code types. Preserve valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at and supersession; do not silently replace a legacy assignment, infer a current code from six digits or treat both systems as the same geographic object.
postal_system.operator_api_rule: QazPost Open API service 26 supports address, new-index and RKA-based search and returns address representations. It requires a bearer token. A pinned response may support a dated code-to-address-object relation only under exact service terms, privacy, retention, rate and display rights. Interactive access and database availability do not authorize harvesting or republication of a national address, customer or geometry corpus.
postal_system.address_register_rule: The Digital Address Register establishes registered address existence and generates a separate 16-character RKA. RKA can stabilize a reviewed postcode-to-address-to-building relation but is not a postcode, AGID cell, cadastral identifier, footprint, ownership record or automatic public-data licence.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared RKA or civic-address identity, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building or parcel geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, address-block component, RKA alone, operator response, cadastral parcel, rights-register result, administrative polygon, coordinate, road, OSM footprint or proximity is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.nsdi_rule: Kazakhstan NSDI supports search, view, download and copy services for generally accessible spatial data, but every exact dataset and service requires its metadata, owner, access class, terms, CRS, topology, validity and digest to be pinned. Portal visibility or a GeoServer endpoint is not a blanket postal, address, building or redistribution licence.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Typed postcodes, permitted address points or surfaces and buildings may link to AGID cells through explicit versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postcode, address block, RKA, address, building, parcel, administrative area or territory as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is QazPost geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Current Kazpost pages and token-gated QazPost API do not by themselves grant bulk address, assignment, geometry or redistribution rights. NSDI accessibility does not override exact-dataset metadata or restrictions. Address-register, cadastre and rights-register materials require exact resource access, rights and privacy review. ODbL data remains separate. Pin every exact resource, terms version, override and digest before promotion.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Operator queries, RKA and address-history services, residential-registration and real-estate-rights records, cadastral identifiers, exact coordinates, entrances, units, recipients, residents, owners, occupants, accounts, bearer tokens and query logs may expose household, property, security or personal context. They are excluded from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postcode systems, assignments, addresses, RKA relations, administrative context, buildings and crosswalks are time-dependent. Store code_type, valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, source version and supersession independently; current and legacy evidence must coexist without rewriting history.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Country code KZ selects a runtime and source contract; it is not a sovereignty, jurisdiction, administrative-boundary or universal-coverage assertion. Province, republican city or capital, district, locality, language, source authority, jurisdiction, validity and licence must be explicit. No postal, government, cadastral, third-party or community source is presumed to cover every area or settle boundary status.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures only; no real data promotion.

Current rights-cleared typed QazPost assignments and independently licensed point or area geometry pass complete declared coverage, current-versus-legacy validity, CRS/topology, RKA/building-link review, privacy, jurisdiction, freshness and digest gates, with reproducible transformation, immutable publication and actual AGID loader/API verification.
